scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained and conditional on a positive coexistence equilibrium; numerical and symbolic checks supplement but do not replace the infinite-dimensional-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires strictly positive fixed isolation, exchange, uptake, mortality, and input parameters.
Positive equilibrium existence is assumed, not inferred.
No conclusions for stochastic supplies, adaptive isolation, or boundary-only dynamics.
Priority check is literature-bounded and independent validation is not performed.
title: Global coexistence rigidity for spatially compartmentalized consumer-resource systems
